contract.label: Combobox
contract.summary: A searchable, optionally multi-select picker: an input group plus a portalled popup list, with optional selected-value chips.

parts.name: Combobox
parts.description: Root managing the value, query, and filtering.

parts.name: ComboboxInput
parts.description: The combobox input, with optional trigger and clear buttons. Takes `surface` (as ComboboxChips) and passes it to its input group.

parts.name: ComboboxContent
parts.description: Portalled, positioned popup panel for the listbox.

parts.name: ComboboxList
parts.description: Scrollable list container holding the items.

parts.name: ComboboxItem
parts.description: A selectable option; shows a check when selected.

parts.name: ComboboxGroup
parts.description: Wraps related items. Required around a ComboboxLabel.

parts.name: ComboboxLabel
parts.description: Muted heading for a group of items.

parts.name: ComboboxCollection
parts.description: Helper that maps data to combobox items.

parts.name: ComboboxEmpty
parts.description: Message shown when no items match the query.

parts.name: ComboboxChips
parts.description: Bordered container laying out selected-value chips + input.

parts.name: ComboboxChip
parts.description: A single selected-value chip with an optional remove button.

parts.name: ComboboxChipsInput
parts.description: Bare inline input used inside the chips container.

parts.name: ComboboxTrigger
parts.description: Button that toggles the popup; appends a chevron.

props.name: surface
props.description: What the field sits on — default inside a card, sheet, dialog or table row, where it rests clear so the surface shows through; page straight on the shell's muted content area, where it takes the outline Button's face so a filter row reads as one surface.

rules: **Pick the surface by what is underneath.** A `ComboboxInput` or `ComboboxChips` placed straight on the shell's `muted` content area — a search box, a filter row — takes `surface="page"`, the outline Button's resting face (`outline-surface`), so the row reads as one surface. Inside a `card`, `sheet`, `dialog` or table row it keeps `default`.
antiPatterns: A field on the muted page body given `bg-background`, `bg-card` or `bg-white` instead of `surface="page"` — in dark mode `background` is darker than `card`, so the field sinks below the cards beside it.
